convention: Each pair joins one DOJ entry to the Federal Register document it is, only where a mechanical basis holds: `title` (DOJ's text equals FR's title, ignoring case) or `slug` (DOJ links the White House page whose URL slug is FR's title, lowercased, with runs of anything but letters and digits as hyphens). check.mjs tests the basis, that the entry exists once, and that FR's record is in fr_presidential_documents. Nothing is matched by date or by a name in the text.
